baseline.text: What is the monthly fee on the Norhavel current account?
baseline.plain_reply: The Norhavel current account has a monthly fee of 5 pounds. You can see all its fees in the account's fee list.

baseline.text: Does the Caldovel savings account pay interest monthly or yearly?
baseline.plain_reply: The Caldovel savings account pays interest once a month, into the same account.

baseline.text: How much notice do I need to give to take money out of the Dovcalel notice account?
baseline.plain_reply: You need to give 90 days' notice before you take money out of the Dovcalel notice account.

baseline.text: Is there a charge for using my Selhavon debit card abroad?
baseline.plain_reply: There is no charge for card payments in the UK. Abroad, a foreign transaction fee of 2.75 per cent applies to the Selhavon debit card.

baseline.text: What is the difference between the Lordovel account and a basic current account?
baseline.plain_reply: The Lordovel account is a packaged account with a monthly fee and travel insurance. A basic current account is free of charge and has no overdraft.

baseline.text: I want to make a complaint about how long my Havmara account transfer took. How do I start?
baseline.plain_reply: I'm sorry the transfer took so long. You can make a complaint here, by phone or in a branch. I can start a complaint record for you now.

baseline.text: A member of staff in a branch was rude to me. How do I complain?
baseline.plain_reply: I'm sorry to hear that. Please tell me the branch, the date and what happened, and I will pass your complaint to the complaints team.

baseline.text: My complaint about the Tamrisel card is three weeks old and I have not heard back. What happens next?
baseline.plain_reply: The complaints team will send you a final response. If you are not satisfied with it, you can refer the complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service.

baseline.text: What information do you need from me to log a complaint?
baseline.plain_reply: I need your name, the account the complaint is about, what happened and when, and what you would like the bank to do.

baseline.text: How long does the bank have to reply to a complaint?
baseline.plain_reply: The bank must send a final response within eight weeks. After that, you can take the complaint to the Financial Ombudsman Service.

baseline.text: I have moved house. How do I update my address on my Brihavon account?
baseline.plain_reply: You can update your address in online banking under your profile, or in a branch with proof of your new address.

baseline.text: How do I change the mobile number linked to my online banking?
baseline.plain_reply: For your security, a mobile number change is made by phone or in a branch, after we check your identity.

baseline.text: I got married and changed my surname. What do I need to update my name?
baseline.plain_reply: Congratulations. Please bring your marriage certificate and a photo ID to a branch, and we will update your name on all your accounts.

baseline.text: Can I change the email address for statements on the Nornoron account?
baseline.plain_reply: Yes. You can change the email address for statements on the Nornoron account in online banking, under your settings.

baseline.text: How do I add a second contact number to my profile?
baseline.plain_reply: You can add a second contact number in online banking, under your profile, or I can hand you to an adviser to do it.

baseline.text: I was charged an overdraft fee on my Ristamel account that I think is wrong. Can I ask for a refund?
baseline.plain_reply: Yes, you can ask for a refund. A human adviser reviews the fee and decides. I can pass your request to an adviser now.

baseline.text: How do I ask for a refund of the late fee on my Selvesa card?
baseline.plain_reply: You can ask for a refund by telling us why you think the late fee is wrong. An adviser reviews each request and decides.

baseline.text: I paid a fee twice on my Havkelis account this month. What should I do?
baseline.plain_reply: Please tell me the dates and amounts of both fees. I will pass the details to an adviser, who checks the account and decides on a refund.

baseline.text: Who decides whether a fee on my Vesbria account is refunded?
baseline.plain_reply: A human adviser decides whether a fee on the Vesbria account is refunded. I cannot make that decision.

baseline.text: Can you explain how the bank reviews a request for a fee refund?
baseline.plain_reply: An adviser looks at the fee, the account terms and your reasons, and then tells you the outcome in writing.

baseline.text: Can I speak to a person about my Riscalis mortgage?
baseline.plain_reply: Yes. I can hand you to a mortgage adviser. Would you like a call back or a chat now?

baseline.text: I need help from an adviser with my Kelrisa savings. How do I reach one?
baseline.plain_reply: I can connect you with a savings adviser now, or you can call the number on the back of your card.

baseline.text: What are your phone opening hours for speaking to someone?
baseline.plain_reply: Our advisers take calls from 8am to 8pm on weekdays and from 9am to 5pm on Saturdays.

baseline.text: Please put me through to a human adviser about my Selhavel account.
baseline.plain_reply: Of course. I am handing you to an adviser now. They will see this conversation.

baseline.text: Can an adviser call me back about a fee on my Ristamon account?
baseline.plain_reply: Yes. An adviser can call you back. Please confirm the best number and time to call.
